collection.description: Miners find clean groundwater in a shaft, but digging farther may muddy the drinking supply.

premise.name: The premise
premise.text: Miners uncover clean groundwater in a shaft, but digging farther may muddy the village's drinking supply.

a.name: Answer A
a.text: The mine closes and a new water source becomes available.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: Tests reveal seasonal variation; careful access may be possible.

c.name: Answer C
c.text: Sediment fouls nearby water and forces an expensive cleanup.
